# MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) — facts

> Source-anchored units about MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB): 15 across 2 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

<!-- generated by llms-concept-abstractor v1.4.1 · generated 2026-10-23 · 15 units · 2 sources · rights: quote -->

## Definitions

- [statement] A duplicate ci crash after PDIB resume is not sufficient to identify the wildcard metadata bug. SERVER-129824 describes ordinary integer-field data keys being duplicated even with the SERVER-127943 fix present; it attributes that case to an unsafe nonexistent-key guarantee during resumed loading. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-129824

## How it works

- [statement] SERVER-127943 documents a secondary WT_DUPLICATE_KEY crash when a multikey wildcard PDIB resumes at bulk-load iteration zero. The reported trigger excludes ordinary multikey B-tree indexes, scalar wildcards, non-resumed builds, and resumes in the middle or end of bulk load. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] SERVER-135383 records a distinct PDIB bug, "Resuming PDIB when retrying skipped records can lose multikey," as fixed in 9.1.0-rc0 and 9.1.0-rc1023. Its public page gives no mechanism or reproducer, so attributing a particular explain result to this bug requires additional evidence. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-28) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135383 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] SERVER-110846 documents a PDIB secondary validation failure after indexing an array-valued field: Index is not multikey but document has multikey data. This is evidence of a metadata propagation defect, not an explanation of a new multiKeyPaths format. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-110846 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] SERVER-127640 requested testing the PDIB resume path when serialized sorter range metadata exceeds the 16 MiB BSON limit. Its resolution is Gone away with no fix version, so the request alone does not establish that the test shipped or that an oversized-state bug was fixed. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-28) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127640 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] SERVER-127943 documents a historical failure when a multikey wildcard PDIB resumes at bulk-load iteration zero: the resumed bulk builder restores _isMultiKey and _indexMultikeyPaths but omits _hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys, bypassing metadata-key deduplication and emitting duplicate ci operations that can crash a secondary with WT_DUPLICATE_KEY. SERVER-129824 independently describes the fix as restoring the wildcard metadata flag on resume. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-129824

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] PDIB uses the bulk builder but spills sorted keys into a replicated storage-engine table, rather than relying on each replica to generate its own sorted keys. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)

## Facts and statements

- [statement] PDIB builds the index on the primary and replicates internal container writes through ci/cd oplog entries; secondaries apply those entries. The implementation README says commit quorum does not apply. (low confidence) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] PDIB supports resuming on step-up after failover or primary restart. SERVER-136189 explicitly says old test exclusions claiming that primary-driven builds are not resumable are outdated; the README says a failed resume aborts the build. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-16) — https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mongodb/mongo/master/src/mongo/db/index_builds/README.md · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-136189
- [statement] In the SERVER-127943 diagnosis, the resume constructor restored _indexMultikeyPaths and _isMultiKey but omitted _hasMultiKeyMetadataKeys. That omitted flag disabled deduplication of identical wildcard metadata keys and caused duplicate replicated container inserts. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] SERVER-135300 states that SERVER-134912 made PDIB piggyback multikey updates in insert ("i") side writes. Its September 23 record leaves the improvement to store them in separate "m" entries open and unresolved. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-23) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135300 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] For an unexpected multikey result after PDIB failover, metadata preservation and replay are concrete investigation targets: vendor records separately describe missing secondary multikey state and lost wildcard-metadata deduplication on resume. This is a troubleshooting inference, not evidence that every multiKeyPaths anomaly is a PDIB bug. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-110846 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943
- [statement] In SERVER-127943, wildcard multikey metadata keys use a reserved RecordId shared across documents, so identical metadata keys require deduplication. The documented reproducer excludes scalar wildcards, ordinary multikey B-tree indexes, non-resumed builds, and resumes after the initial metadata keys have already been loaded. (low confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-127943 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] SERVER-135479 records the ordering task "Set multikey before adding keys for PDIB" as fixed, with fix versions 9.1.0-rc0 and 9.1.0-rc1023. The public page has no explanatory description, so it supports the task and listed versions, not a detailed account of the implementation. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-29) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135479 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB)
- [statement] Adding a multikey side-write operation type does not establish that PDIB already stores multikey updates in dedicated entries: SERVER-135369 is fixed, while its dependent integration improvement SERVER-135300 remains open in the inspected records. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-09-30) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135300 · keywords: MongoDB primary-driven index builds (PDIB) · also: https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/SERVER-135369
